The website and software

AWTechs provides this website to explain Perch and help users access its source and documentation. Perch is free, self-hosted, open-source software distributed under the MIT licence. The licence governs use, modification and redistribution of the software.

Your server and commands

You are responsible for the infrastructure on which you install Perch, the permissions you grant, the clients you connect and the commands you approve. Only manage systems you own or are authorised to administer. Protect credentials, review commands and maintain backups and an independent recovery method.

One-time approval and saved rules permit command execution; they do not guarantee that a command is safe. A privileged command can modify or destroy data, expose secrets or alter the server and Perch itself.

No hosted administration service

This website does not provide VPS hosting, relay command traffic, execute commands or grant access to an AWTechs server. Each user supplies and operates their own Perch instance. Third-party hosting and AI services may have their own charges and terms.

Availability and support

Perch is early alpha. AWTechs offers no uptime guarantee, response-time commitment or managed-server obligation. Support is available through GitHub issues.
